title: How Did Sailors Find Their Way Before GPS?

shots.say: It's midnight on the open sea, and the coast vanished three days ago.
No map shows where you are.
No machine tells you which way is home.
One wrong guess, and the water runs out before the land appears.
And yet, for thousands of years, sailors crossed oceans like this and came back.
So how did they find their way with nothing but the sky?
Every star you see at night slowly wheels across the sky.
Except one. In the north, a single star barely moves at all.
Find it, and you know which way is north.
Measure how high it sits above the horizon, and you know how far north you are.
